name: yierbubu-promo
description: YierBubu-Pet promo video (Remotion). Designed by 黄小B · Powered by noSugarK

scripts.prepare-assets: node scripts/bears.mjs && node scripts/audio.mjs && node scripts/fonts.mjs
scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts Landscape out/yierbubu-landscape.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 && remotion render src/index.ts Portrait out/yierbubu-portrait.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
